projects.Title: Meditation sessions counter
projects.Description: The Weekly Meditation Session Counter — a nice little habit-building tool.

projects.Title: Add to Cart Mobile App (PWA)
projects.Description: Let this cute cat remember what you need to buy. Shop with confidence, fun, and ease like a breeze.

projects.Title: Good News App
projects.Description: Tired of only bad news everywhere? While taking care of what you can and helping where possible, contribute to spreading light and positivity. Share something good and valuable to you.

projects.Title: Twitter, or X, clone
projects.Description: A Twitter, or X, clone with unique content and awesome functionality. It shows what the version of X might look like in the Wizarding World of Harry Potter.

projects.Title: Christmas Meme Picker
projects.Description: Select your current emotion and see a cute Christmas cat or dog feeling the same! Happy Holidays!

projects.Title: Eco Travel Hub
projects.Description: EcoTravelHub is your go-to destination for exploring the world sustainably! This project aims to promote eco-friendly travel, providing valuable information and resources for conscious adventurers. Fully responsive website. Built with a mobile-first approach and accessibility in mind.

projects.Title: Learning Journal
projects.Description: A personal project documenting my journey into Frontend development. This repository serves as a digital diary where I share insights, experiences, and the milestones achieved on this coding adventure.

projects.Title: Coffee Time with Me app
projects.Description: Coffee Time with Me aims to bring people together for virtual coffee chats where we can discuss programming, network, and have a great time together. Whether you're a coding enthusiast or just someone who enjoys good conversations, this is the place for you! I will be happy to meet you!

projects.Title: Coffee Shop Ordering App
projects.Description: Browse the beautiful menu online, choose your favorite coffee, pay in a few clicks, and enjoy!

projects.Title: Color Scheme Generator
projects.Description: Generate an awesome color scheme for your project! Choose a base color and a color mode according to color-wheel combinations, and generate a 5-color scheme. It is displayed with corresponding hex values. And you can easily copy colors to your clipboard by clicking on them or their hex values!

projects.Title: Repair Service Company Website
projects.Description: I built a website for a small company of my father and his friends. The company offers repair services for computers and home appliances. The website provides information about the services offered, company background, client feedback, frequently asked questions, and contact details.

projects.Title: Movie Watchlist
projects.Description: A little but cute web app that allows you to search for movies and add them to a watchlist. You can view your watchlist on a separate page. And then watch these gems one by one!

projects.Title: Wins App
projects.Description: Save your achievements as you make them, and then add them to your CV or tell your mom!

projects.Title: Travel Wishboard
projects.Description: My travel wishboard, or bucket list, where I keep track of my dream destinations that I would like to visit.

projects.Title: Image Upscaler
projects.Description: AI and JavaScript work together to help you enlarge your images without losing quality. You can use it on your phone or computer. A great tool to have on hand! (Built in collaboration with a UX/UI designer. He made a great design in Figma, and I coded everything.)

projects.Title: Quiz App
projects.Description: An app where you can challenge yourself with a little quiz about science and nature.

projects.Title: Golden Hour App
projects.Description: An app to determine when you will have this beautiful time of golden hour in your location today.

projects.Title: Portfolio Builder App
projects.Description: An app to build, publish, share, and download a personalized, clean, and responsive portfolio for a professional in any industry.

projects.Title: Momentum Platform
projects.Description: An app that helps makers of handmade products, like clothes, jewelry, and handmade candies, manage their business. The all-in-one studio assistant for handmade creators — not a shop, not a CRM, but a powerful, calm, and pretty command center for your business.

projects.Title: Christmas Advent of Kindness Calendar App
projects.Description:
A Christmas Advent of Kindness Calendar app with daily challenges to boost your confidence and encourage you to do a kind thing every day.

When a user completes a challenge, they receive a promocode for a product from an indie hacker or a company, or just a link to other valuable items (without a promocode, including free and open source ones).
